h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Hospet

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Hospet

items.pText: Hospet, now officially Hosapete, is the closest town to the ruins of Hampi and sits beside the Tungabhadra dam. Canals from the reservoir run through the farmland around it, and mining and steel have brought townships and schools to the area. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment here from our factory in Vasai, about 590 km away, and sends it to Karnataka by road.

Where a site lies near water, the first planning question is where to put the play area, before what to put in it. Children run straight off a slide or a swing without looking, so canals, tanks, swimming pools and deep drains must be well away from the play zone. We mark these hazards on the layout drawing from your photos and plan the equipment around them. The weather here is hot and dry for most of the year, with a short monsoon.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Siting a play area away from water and drains

c: Choose the part of the plot furthest from canals, ponds or open drains, and put a fence or hedge between the two if the gap is small. Turn slide exits and swing arcs away from the water side, so a child coming off the equipment runs into open ground. At a hotel or resort near Hampi, keep the play area outside the pool enclosure altogether. Check that the gate of the play area does not open straight onto a road or a water channel.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: How far should a playground be from a pool or canal?
items.a: As far as the site allows, with a fence between them if the gap is small. We mark water bodies and drains on the layout drawing and turn slide exits and swings away from them.

items.q: Can resorts near Hampi order playground equipment?
items.a: Yes. Resorts, hotels, schools and townships around Hospet can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install through our own team or a dealer in Karnataka.

items.q: Which materials suit Hospet's dry heat?
items.a: Galvanised steel frames and roto-moulded plastic parts handle long, hot summers well. Plan shade over slides and decks, and use rubber flooring instead of loose soil, which turns dusty and hard.
